1.w: A song of ascents. How blessed is every one of the Lord ’s loyal followers, each one who keeps his commands.

2.w: You will eat what you worked so hard to grow. You will be blessed and secure.

3.w: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine in the inner rooms of your house; your children will be like olive branches, as they sit all around your table.

4.w: Yes indeed, the man who fears the Lord will be blessed in this way.

5.w: May the Lord bless you from Zion that you might see Jerusalem prosper all the days of your life

6.w: and that you might see your grandchildren. May Israel experience peace.
